notes.title: Nemesis Realms: Lich release trailer
notes.notes:
The newest boss to join Nemesis Realms is the Lich!
Unleash gravity, tear realities apart, freeze your enemies. Destroy worlds as the Lich.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JxJHY3QaExs

Now live on Steam Early Access!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/716750/Nemesis_Realms/

Join the conversation on Reddit:
https://www.reddit.com/r/NemesisRealms/

notes.title: System Update 22.12.2016
notes.notes:
- Current controller support:
 - Xbox 360
 - Xbox 360 Wireless
 - Xbox One
 - PlayStation 4
 - Steam Controller

Update:
- Tweaked controller support for other manufacturers (such as Logitech, Madcatz etc.) 
- Fixed issues with audio
